description: Peekaboo 3.x targeted macOS automation. Mutations are not certified focus-isolated and require explicit foreground control with a visible activity indicator.

permissions.title: Inspect a targeted app
permissions.description: Read a bounded accessibility tree for an explicitly targeted app or window.

permissions.title: Act on a targeted control
permissions.description: Perform a semantic press or set a semantic value on an explicitly selected accessibility control without global input.

permissions.title: Capture a targeted window
permissions.description: Capture one explicitly targeted app window to a private short-lived artifact.

permissions.title: Control the foreground desktop
permissions.description: Use global pointer, keyboard, focus, or scrolling. ZenX exposes these as explicitly labeled, cancellable foreground takeover.

tools.name: computer_environment
tools.description: Read the current desktop session and power availability. lockedTools names this provider’s scoped capabilities while locked; re-inspect for fresh controls and treat native failures as failures. Window capture and foreground input require an active session. This read does not wake, unlock, or operate another app.

tools.name: computer_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a bounded first page of at most 32 controls in one exact app window, or follow nextCursor without recapture. Coverage separately reports available pages and native omissions; this is not a complete accessibility tree. Model callers use since with an exact observation ref to request a diff; omit it or set full:true to resync. target.windowTitle is required.

cursor.description: Continue the exact immutable captured observation using its returned nextCursor. Does not recapture or renew action references. Omit to inspect afresh.

baseObservationId.description: Request a diff only when you still retain that observation's full first-page baseline (or have applied its diffs). Omit after context compaction or lost context to receive a self-contained full view.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

tools.name: computer_press
tools.description: Peekaboo targeted press; may affect foreground focus/input. Requires explicit foreground control; never a background fallback. A successful dispatch does not verify application effect.

tools.name: computer_set_value
tools.description: Peekaboo targeted value change; may affect foreground focus/input. Requires explicit foreground control; never a background fallback. A successful dispatch does not verify application effect.

tools.name: computer_screenshot
tools.description: Capture one explicit app/window target to a private five-minute PNG artifact. Returns metadata/path, never pixels in the Thread journal.

tools.name: computer_foreground_click
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: move and click the real global pointer. ZenX shows the running tool before input begins; Stop cancels it.

tools.name: computer_foreground_key_press
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: press one allowlisted key in the focused control. Stop cancels the running operation.

tools.name: computer_foreground_scroll
tools.description: FOREGROUND TAKEOVER: scroll the current foreground target. Stop cancels the running operation.

name: Computer
mainDocument: If available, start with computer_list_windows; its query filters windows only. Otherwise use the supplied exact window target. Prefer a returned exact window ref with computer_inspect; providers without discovery accept an explicit native window target. Inspect coverage and follow nextCursor alone to read the immutable captured controls beyond the first page; native traversal omissions remain explicit and are not recoverable by paging. References express exact-fingerprint presentation continuity, not proven native object identity. Actions use exact control refs and native revalidation. Pass since with a retained observation ref for a diff; omit since or set full:true after context compaction/lost context. For retained controls, pass the control ref with an explicit latest observation ref; native action checks still decide freshness. Cursor pages do not replace the first-page diff baseline or renew action authority. Discard prior continuation pages on every new observation or first-page diff and follow its new nextCursor for tails. Prefer background-safe semantic controls. This Peekaboo variant does not expose computer_list_windows; use an explicitly supplied target. Its targeted press/value mutations are not certified focus-isolated: they require explicit foreground control and cannot be used as a background fallback. Backend completion does not verify application effect.
